primary_claim: Using their own prior 'Pinocchio dimension' psychometric construct (Plisiecki et al. 2026) measuring LLMs' self-attribution of phenomenality (neuroticism, vivid imagination, inner speech, wellbeing, self-attribution of positive emotions), the author reports an exploratory negative trend where newer/more heavily fine-tuned high-end models (e.g. nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, gpt-5.4-pro, kimi-k2.6) tend to score lower on the Pinocchio (Π) dimension over release date, consistent with Binz et al. (2026)'s finding that post-training makes LLMs less human-like, and interprets this as fine-tuning suppressing human-like traits such as neuroticism/negativity to improve usability.

effect.metric: Pinocchio dimension (Π) score vs. model release date
effect.value: negative trend of Π over release date, largely driven by high-end model cluster; large within-provider and within-family variance (e.g. gpt-5.4 and gpt-5.4-pro sit at opposite ends of the Π distribution despite likely sharing a base model)

depends_on: arXiv:2605.07632 (Binz et al. 2026, Post-training makes LLMs less human-like)
arXiv:2605.05080 (Plisiecki et al. 2026, The Pinocchio Dimension)
stated_future_work: determine in what specific way LLMs become behaviorally misaligned from humans, and whether only some facets of human experience are worse internalized
determine whether behavioral misalignment translates to misaligned third-person modeling of human behavior
determine whether the behavioral misalignment/drift is a conscious steering choice by AI labs or an uncontrolled by-product of finetuning
determine whether LLMs can be fine-tuned without misaligning them behaviorally
limitations_stated: the extent to which models can be positioned on the Π dimension may be largely sample-dependent, so model- and provider-level comparisons are exploratory only
does not distinguish whether behavioral drift is an intended lab choice versus an unintended side effect of fine-tuning
quote: The negative trend is largely driven by the cluster of high-end models, including nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b, gpt-5.4-pro, and kimi-k2.6.
